zh-CN: 目录检查无变化时提示项目名，排队冲突说明更清楚，原位置可在打开旁修改。
二次压缩支持保留、更新或逐项确认备份位置，仅冲突任务等待确认。
三档缩略图统一每页三行并保持翻页位置；按钮新增扩散淡出的圆角提示框，大小/状态列收窄为 64px。
联网检查和历史只接受 main 稳定版本；本机 ZIP 仍可安装更高的测试版本。
README 截图改用发行包内的四个资源；极小文件 MD5 跳过默认阈值改为 1 KB。
用户资料和仓库格式保持兼容，无需迁移。
en-US: Unchanged folder checks identify the item; queue conflicts are explained and originals can be edited beside Open.
Later compression can keep, update, or individually review backup locations; only conflicts wait for confirmation.
All thumbnail sizes use three rows and preserve paging position; the button gains a fading rounded outline and Size / Status narrows to 64 px.
Online checks and history accept only stable main Releases; local ZIP selection still permits higher test versions.
README screenshots now use the four packaged assets; the tiny-file MD5 skip default is 1 KB.
User data and Warehouse formats remain compatible; no migration is needed.
